recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Future changes to BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense Scope and Usage or terminology should be handled in HL7/oo-incubator unless the resource returns to the active FHIR-core build. Do not remove preparation or in-progress from the status code system without a separate final work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-41872 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested clearer BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense scope language so a dispense is understood as completed only after necessary product approvals and medical release conditions for the patient have been met. The original proposal also suggested removing preparation and in-progress statuses, but the final disposition approved the narrower Scope and Usage sentence referring to completion at status=allocated or issued.
initial_application: Core commit ef2a727c1576e6c14864af62f868570203a3397c applied FHIR-41872 on 2024-04-15 by adding the approved sentence to source/biologicallyderivedproductdispense/biologicallyderivedproductdispense-introduction.xml. The local out-of-build core copy still contains that sentence. The status values preparation and in-progress are retained consistently with the separate Published FHIR-40329 status-code decision.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini lists BiologicallyDerivedProduct but not BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense as an active core resource, and current BDP module links point to the OO Incubator IG. Core commits 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 and 01706a920f4e88452c409c2cc0b7c74f09ac51c6 removed OO additional-resource build entries and redirected links to https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/oo-incubator/. The current HL7/oo-incubator pagecontent source for StructureDefinition-BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense includes the FHIR-41872 Scope and Usage sentence. FHIR-53609 and FHIR-53637 are external FHIR-oo-incubator follow-up issues, not current core edits in this run.
